title: Certify course catalog
description: The single source of truth for the Certify catalog. Generated from the site's course content and published at https://certify.courses/catalog.json. The mobile app fetches this at runtime; it describes ONLY course/content metadata. Per-user progress (how many lessons a learner finished) and per-device download state are NOT in this file — the app merges those locally by cert id.

version.description: Contract/schema version. Bump only on a breaking shape change so old app builds can refuse an incompatible manifest and fall back to their bundled copy.

generated_at.description: When the generator last emitted this file. Used for cache diagnostics/'last updated'.

id.description: Stable, kebab-case identity. NEVER reused or renamed — the app merges local progress/download state onto this key. Renaming an id silently resets a learner's progress.

track.description: Human course title, e.g. "Data Engineer Associate".

exam_code.description: Vendor exam code (e.g. "DEA-C01"). null/omitted when the vendor has no short code (most Databricks certs). App must tolerate a missing code.

monogram.description: Short badge label rendered on the card, e.g. "D", "aws", "Az".

accent.description: Card accent colour, hex #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. (Replaces the old decimal accent_argb int — see README app-side change.)

lesson_url.description: Full URL the WebView opens for this course. For status=planned this may point at the site root; the app must NOT navigate planned certs regardless.

lessons_total.description: Total lessons/chapters the finished course will have. 0 for planned certs with no content yet. Drives the progress denominator; numerator is local.

status.description: CONTENT availability, not learner progress. live = all lessons published; authoring = some lessons live, more being written; planned = announced, no content (do not navigate); retiring = live but the exam is being withdrawn (see available_until).

available_until.description: Optional. For status=retiring: last date the exam can be taken.

exam_available_from.description: Optional. First date the vendor exam can be sat (for brand-new exams).

questions_total.description: Optional. Number of practice questions in the course's question bank. Omit (don't emit 0) when the course has no question bank yet.

mocks_total.description: Optional. Number of full-length mock exams. Omit when there are none.

level.description: Optional. The vendor's certification tier. Rendered as a chip on the card.

last_verified.description: Optional. ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the content was last checked against the vendor's current exam guide.

icon.description: Optional. Topic icon key. Apps render their own glyph per key and fall back to the monogram for missing or unknown keys, so new keys can be added without breaking old builds.

practice_url.description: Optional. Absolute URL of the course's practice-question page.

ready_url.description: Optional. Absolute URL of the 'Am I ready?' readiness check.

guide_url.description: Optional. Absolute URL of the exam-guide page.

price.description: Optional. Display-only price string including currency, e.g. "$9.99". Not a purchase link; the app hides it by default.

price_note.description: Optional. Short qualifier shown next to price, e.g. "one-time unlock after free Unit 1".

units.description: Optional top-level sections/domains of the course. Emitted by the generator from the course's real section list; may be omitted until wired up.

size_mb.description: Optional download size. Omit until offline downloads are implemented.
